scope: physical sensing only; supplied annotations, never HA actions
validity_note: Usable means a supplied decision without a reported error; run strict validation upstream.

event_matching.kind_and_object_label: case/whitespace-normalized exact match; no inferred aliases

events.false_events_per_hour_unavailable_reason: Requires explicit exhaustive class/time coverage, labeled events (including empty negatives), and stable timeline IDs for every evaluated row; unannotated extras are not false events.

exhaustive_subset.scope: Only explicit exhaustive class/time intervals; overlapping intervals counted once per timeline

event_confidence_calibration.scope: Matched positives plus covered false events with numeric confidence only; selection-biased when annotation coverage is partial. Not population calibration.
event_confidence_calibration.textual_uncertainty_reason: No reference rubric for free-text uncertainty is supplied.

timing.detection_delay_unavailable_reason: No matched events with explicit source-to-wall clock mapping and measured emission time.
timing.delay_scope: Only matched events; model latency is reported separately and is not detection delay.

tracking.unavailable_reason: No supervised frame boxes; source noun labels do not establish detections or tracks.
tracking.identity_switch_definition: Changed predicted track ID between consecutive matched annotations of the same GT track/timeline; unmatched gaps do not reset identity; not IDF1 or HOTA.
